title: The Magikitos Adventure
description: A forest, a little elf, and all the time in the world.

intro: The forest smells lovely. No hurry today. Let's see what's happening around here.
night: Stories make the night last here.
neighborGreeting: I went out to do nothing. So far, so good.
world: A little world. A big adventure.
missingMedia: This media lives on Hetzner and is unavailable in this local copy.

hint: Tap to walk or use arrows/WASD. Space while walking or double-tap: roll. Tap objects to discover them.
neighborDoor: Out for a walk. The sign says: “Back when I’m back.”
noPooping: “No pooping here.” There’s a picture of a dog. Technically, my ears are different.
tavernTable: This is where bad jokes get told twice. In case you missed how bad they were.
humanBed: A human bed. Room for seven of us. Or one lying diagonally.
humanTable: Everything is enormous. That spoon could be my boat.
empty: There’s room for plenty more stories here.
workshopDialogue: Magikitos are born here, one by one, made by hand. Mine says his hair just grew like that. I didn’t ask.
usePrompt: Using :item · Tap an object in the world
noUse: That doesn’t look like a great combination. My insurance doesn’t cover experiments.
reusable: Reusable tool · Stays in your sack
bagEmpty: One bit of fluff. So much potential. Let’s find something.
lighterDescription: Borrowed from a human house. Lights campfires and stays with you for future adventures.
mushroomDescription: A clearing mushroom, ready to slice and make a skewer.
fireLit: It's lit! And all my eyebrows are intact. The coals are ready for a skewer.
forestDirections: Cross the bridge to the village. The little house by the fountain has useful bits. Boats and fireside stories await at the lake.
humanDrawers: Smells of wood, wool and things humans lose. Maybe there’s something useful nearby.
cottageBed: One bed, zero meetings. This human knows how to live.
ambientGarden: I’m watching the grass grow. So far, it’s winning.
ambientHat: My hat isn’t crooked. It’s thinking sideways.
ambientLake: I came to listen to the water. It hasn’t asked me for any favors yet.
ambientHunger: That rumbling? Bramble by the barbecue. His tummy sounds like a thunderstorm.
contentInItsPlace: Discover this in its own corner of the world.
picnicHungry: Sniff… I'm so hungry even my hat is rumbling. Fancy making me a mushroom skewer? This barbecue won't cook by itself.
picnicSmellsGood: That smell… Is it for me? I promise to chew. At least the first two times.
picnicThanks: That skewer was brilliant! Here's :reward setines for the boat there and back. I'll be here having a very important lie-down.
picnicAfter: I'm still savouring that skewer. If my eyes are shut, I'm writing the restaurant review in my head.
twigDescription: Straight, sturdy and officially inedible. Perfect for a skewer.
skewerDescription: Golden grilled mushroom. The barbecue neighbour keeps glancing over.
picnicMushroom: A lovely mushroom. Into the sack. Sliced onto a stick and grilled… There's potential.
picnicTwig: A perfect skewer stick. Not every treasure shines. Some poke.
picnicLighter: A lighter on the little table! Into the sack. That barbecue is getting its spark.
barbecueHint: Mushroom, twig and lighter: a cracking skewer awaits. Try the little village house near the fountain.
skewerReady: Mushroom, twig and lighter. We have a restaurant. Shall we make a skewer for the neighbour?
skewerNeedLighter: Skewer ingredients, no spark. Check the little table in the village house by the fountain.
skewerNeedTwig: Mushroom and lighter, ready. We need a twig to keep our fingers ungrilled. There are usually some by the fallen log.
skewerNeedMushroom: Fire and twigs aren't edible. Well, once, perhaps. Better not. We need a mushroom from the clearing.
skewerCooked: Golden skewer, into the sack! Let's take it to Bramble before his tummy wakes the whole forest.
barbecueAfter: My first skewer. Not a single eyebrow lost. The grill stays here. One day it'll smell glorious again.
ferryWelcome: All aboard, mate! :price setines each way. The breeze is on the house. Coming?
ferryPoor: Bit short on setines, mate. Ask around: somebody always appreciates a hand.
shellDescription: A handful of shells. Someone on the islet could use them.
shellRequest: I make shell buttons, mate. Bring a handful from the east shore and I'll pay :price setines. Always happy to buy more!
shellFound: Shells for the neighbour. Not one complained about the trip into the sack.
shellOffer: How lovely! May I have them for my buttons?
shellThanks: Lovely shells! Here's :price setines. The shore keeps bringing more if you fancy earning a bit extra.
isletBench: Water everywhere and not a meeting in sight. This bench has potential.
isletGreeting: I came to watch the waves. Haven't seen them all yet.
walletLocal: Adventure test balance. Does not change your account's setines.
travelError: Couldn't prepare the trip. Your items and setines are safe. Please try again.
ferryHint: Hey, little deckhand! Poke around and someone might pay your fare. Go chat with the locals!
needPoop: Need a poo. Urgent bottom business.
needLeaf: Hmm… first I need a leaf to wipe my little bum.
noNeed: Nothing brewing right now. Back to exploring!
poopIncludesPee: This calls for a squat, mate. Two jobs in one!
peeDone: Aaah… that's better. Back to my very busy day of wandering.
poopDone: What a relief! One leaf used, bum all tidy.
leafDescription: Big, soft and never prickly. One leaf is used to wipe after each poo.
leafFound: One leaf in the sack. Forest paper, deluxe bottom edition!
leafFull: 99 leaves! You're carrying a paper shop, mate.
needsHelp: Real time, even while the game is closed: wee every 6–10 hours, poo every 8–16. A poo relieves both. No rush or penalties.
doorAgain: “The squirrel’s out too.” I hadn’t asked. But good to know.
fountainWish: I made a wish without tossing a coin. It doesn’t say you have to pay.
fisherDoor: Someone here fishes for stories. Fish are far too slippery.
campBench: A bench by the fire. Lovely. Even my to-do list can take the night off.
lakeBench: Water, shade and a bench. Someone's got the right idea.
